Postgres on Neon deployed, SQLite on your laptop, one layer over both: runs, companies, hunter_cache, news_cache, send_log, login_attempts, decision_log. Every field keeps its quote and its source, which is what the card shows you and what the traceability check reads back.
one more page, at most two
a name, a title, an email
dropped: the rule and the quote

Read it in order: 1 to 18 is the order pipeline.py runs them. The hard filters fire before any news is fetched, and the contact is looked up last of the three, so a company that fails a filter costs no Hunter search.
Set once: ICP is fintech, healthtech or devtools, 10-100 people, Series A to C. Daily send cap 15, at most 15 domains a run, 240 seconds a domain. Every send goes to TO_EMAIL and nowhere else.

Never: sends without a human approval, states a fact it did not find, quotes negative news in the email, searches the same domain on Hunter twice, or turns "not shown on the site" into "not certified".
Not built: discovery (the companies are still your list, not found from the signals) and the feedback loop (your edits are stored and nothing reads them).
